findings.batchLifetime: initialCases and finalCases maps are local to each resolveMany call, separate by observation phase, keyed by complete stored caseRef (id, incarnation, producer version). No cache survives across calls, actors or phases.
findings.resultAndCaseFences: Each result, including duplicate refs, retains two independent authenticated store reads and its own canonical projection. All result rereads finish before final case observations. Full case digests are compared; id/incarnation/version and exact alternative/result association are checked. Returned callback objects are detached before later callbacks.
findings.consumerFences: Comparison uses fresh batches for initial, recheck and final criteria observations. Sensitivity units use two fresh batches while retaining independent store, evidence, case and host validation. Legacy hosts remain supported; explicit batch refusal/cardinality mismatch never falls back.
findings.sourceProjectionWiring: Planner port builds the complete DomainProjection from real source projection, evidence, period, actor and environment before C10 comparison qualification. The stored scenario host consumes only FinancialAnalysis.baseline. The two WP11 fixtures now use an actual source Planner for that projection; no financial formula or output is supplied by the fixture.
findings.coverageRemainsReal: Persisted scenario results and bases remain untouched. The classified Planner/sources remain on mutations, baseline coverage, compareScenarios, criteria evaluation and comparePlannerPreview. Those consumers still compare the current C10 basis/assessment and revalidate source and authority. An unavailable source-only FinancialAnalysis comparison is never promoted to complete.
findings.sourceAndActorFreshness: Source Planner retains real source resolution, authenticated domain reads, exact projection digest, repeated source observations and final host/coverage consistency checks. No source result or authority is cached between calls.
findings.testInvariants: All three original replace operations, monetary assertions, source revision, choice/replay/restart and permission negatives, plus the 180000ms test/fixture deadline, remain unchanged by these two fixture patches.
findings.typesAndDependencies: The optional batch method and exported ResolvedScenario type are additive; imported result types exist in W8. Current Sucafinav1 configuration does not enable noUncheckedIndexedAccess. No new product dependency or static type blocker was found; no local typecheck ran.

producerTestDesign.uses: Real UI admission, scoped source issuer, canonical Planner, C08 state and case/result stores. Coverage inventory/membership remain explicit fixture inputs.
asserts: Two case observations per sibling batch, individual result rereads and projections.
Fresh subsequent batches; detached duplicate values.
Identical units with batched versus legacy resolution; asserted case counts six versus ten await CI.
Independent actors, distinct cases and historical producer versions, stable ordering/cardinality and missing-result refusal.
Ledger, alternative and coverage drift without a version shortcut.
Authority revocation after result rereads and real Planner source changes.
Retained callback object mutation and malformed cardinality/failure without fallback.
